final: WITH per_account AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, a.account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN 1.0*t.amount END) AS avg_amount, AVG(1.0*t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id=a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id=d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3,a.account_id), per_region AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS region_avg_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS region_avg_balance FROM per_account GROUP BY region) SELECT region, region_avg_amount, region_avg_balance, region_avg_amount / (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) FROM per_region) AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM per_region
